title: 第910章 联姻之事要慎重第909章 陈归尘不爽了
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
凌霄殿内。
随着姜夜与炎璃公主之间的谈话逐渐深入，原本只是流于表面的交流，似乎也多了一层别样的意味。
在场诸多魔族强者，皆不是寻常人物。
到了他们这个层次，很多事情根本不需要明说。
一个眼神。
一句话。
甚至一个座位之间的距离。
都足以代表许多含义。
当姜夜数次提及两族未来合作之时，又刻意提到了炎璃公主的名字，众人便已经隐隐察觉到了其中的深意。
姜族神子。
似乎真的有意与炎狱魔宫联姻？
当然。
这件事姜夜并没有直接挑明。
以他的身份，也不需要如此。
永恒姜族的神子，若是真的想要迎娶一位魔族女子，哪怕对方是炎狱魔尊之女，也绝不会是他需要主动求娶。
更何况。
如今的局势之下。
这更像是一种双方都心知肚明的试探。
姜夜给出了态度。
剩下的，便看炎狱魔宫如何回应。

“炎璃公主。”
姜夜端起酒杯，轻轻晃动其中的琼浆。
金色眸子看向她，带着几分笑意。
“修行之路漫长，能够在如此岁月达到这种境界，无论放在哪里，都足以称得上一句惊艳。”
炎璃看着他。
不得不承认。
姜夜说话确实让人很舒服。
没有寻常人面对她时的刻意讨好，也没有因为双方身份不同而表现出高高在上的姿态。
更多的是一种平等的交流。
这与她曾经见过的那些所谓天骄，完全不同。
魔族崇尚力量。
强者为尊。
在魔界，女子同样如此。
炎璃虽然身为公主，但她更希望别人认可的是她自身的实力，而不是炎狱魔宫的身份。
而姜夜。
恰好看到了这一点。
“姜神子倒是会说话。”
炎璃轻笑一声。
“不过，你我之间如今谈这些，是不是有些太早了？”
她说得很直接，没有扭捏，也没有故作羞涩。

这便是魔族的性格。
喜欢就是喜欢。
不喜欢就是不喜欢。
content_en:
In the Lingxiao Palace.
As the conversation between Jiang Ye and Princess Yanli gradually deepened, the originally superficial exchange seemed to have a different meaning.
Many powerful demons present were not ordinary people.
At their level, many things don't need to be explained at all.
A look.
One sentence.
Even the distance between seats.
are enough to represent many meanings.
When Jiang Ye mentioned the future cooperation between the two clans several times, and also deliberately mentioned Princess Yanli's name, everyone had already faintly noticed the deeper meaning.
The god son of the Jiang clan.
It seems that he really intends to marry with the Flame Hell Demon Palace?
certainly.
Jiang Ye did not directly mention this matter.
With his status, there is no need for this.
If the divine son of the Eternal Jiang Clan really wants to marry a demon woman, even if she is the daughter of the Flame Hell Demon Lord, he will never need to take the initiative to propose marriage.
not to mention.
Under the current situation.
This is more like a trial that both parties know well.
Jiang Ye gave his attitude.
The rest depends on how the Flame Hell Demon Palace responds.
"Princess Yanli."
Jiang Ye picked up the wine glass and gently shook the wine in it.
Golden eyes looked at her with a hint of smile.
"The road to spiritual practice is long. To be able to reach this state in such a long time is enough to be regarded as amazing no matter where it is placed."
Yanli looked at him.
Have to admit.
Jiang Ye's words really made people feel comfortable.
There was no deliberate attempt to please her as ordinary people would do when facing her, and no condescending attitude due to their different identities.
It's more of an equal exchange.
This was completely different from the so-called geniuses she had seen before.
Demons worship power.
The strong are respected.
In the devil world, the same is true for women.
Although Yan Li is a princess, she hopes that others will recognize her own strength rather than her identity in the Flame Hell Demon Palace.
And Jiang Ye.
Just happened to see this.
"Jiang Shenzi can talk."
Yan Li chuckled.
"However, isn't it a little too early for you and me to talk about this?"
She spoke very directly, without being coy or pretending to be shy.
This is the character of the demons.
If you like it, you just like it.
If you don't like it, you don't like it.
